carrier_definition.H_t: H_t(z)=int_0^infty exp(t u^2) Phi(u) cos(z u) du
carrier_definition.Lambda: inf{t in R: H_t has only real zeros}
carrier_definition.residual: Xi_DBN = max(Lambda,0) under Rodgers-Tao Lambda>=0; closure is Lambda<=0, equivalently Lambda=0

RH_equivalence: RH is equivalent to Lambda <= 0; with Rodgers-Tao Lambda >= 0, RH is equivalent to Lambda = 0.

Rodgers_Tao_proved_lower_bound.source: Brad Rodgers and Terence Tao, The de Bruijn-Newman constant is non-negative, arXiv:1801.05914

Polymath15_upper_bound.source: D. H. J. Polymath, Effective approximation of heat flow evolution of the Riemann xi function, arXiv:1904.12438

retained_nogos: does not convert Rodgers-Tao lower bound into upper bound
